findings.text: The Test page does not load: both shots show "Page Load Error — 404 — nothing matches "/framework/core/Test/"" (requirement 2, "results in a JSONL the site can show"; page 1). Cause: `core/page.js` declares `children: "View Page Router App Sidebar Shell Search Layout Section Item List Property Task"` (line 9), and `Test` is not in that list. This is true in the worktree too, so the page will still 404 after the merge. The fix is to add `Test` to that line.

The new rule in `code/dos-and-donts/readme.md` was pasted into the middle of another bullet. It now sits between "Every process you start is hidden — … PowerShell uses" and its continuation, "`Start-Process -WindowStyle Hidden`…". Both bullets read wrong (diff.patch, first hunk). Move the new line below the end of the "hidden" bullet (requirement 3, "the `code` rules"; words).

The first full run in results.jsonl shows 16 of 101 lines failing (15 test files fail). Most fail with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND for `@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk`, which is missing in the worktree. The readme says this, but once results.jsonl is merged, the page will show these worktree-only failures as real ones. Re-run in the main tree after the merge.

`TestRunner.run()` removes a file from `running` only after it returns. If `one()` hits the `error` path, the file is still removed, so this is fine. But `watch()` calls `run()` without `await` or `catch`, so an exception thrown there would be an unhandled rejection (TestRunner.mjs, `fire`).
The plan says "for now the one command" for run on change. Nothing hosts `--watch` yet; the readme marks this ⬜ (requirement 2, "run on change for core/Item and core/Task": partly met).
